title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-30 Deligne record with cumulative touched-paper readers
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. The first two PDFs are cumulative working readers for the Deligne papers touched so far: one English translation reader and one French working-LaTeX reader. Individual English paper PDFs are also exposed for direct download. Reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [######----] active touched-paper stream: 14 paper-level English working translations are in the current cumulative reader; [######----] French working LaTeX is present for the same touched-paper set, with varying polish by paper; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved in artifact ZIPs. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX by automated transcription systems, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper and work status.
notes: Latest update promotes the complete touched-paper Deligne redo package as cumulative English and French working readers, with individual English paper PDFs and full TeX/PDF artifacts preserved in the ZIP layer.
